summary: Full-stack smoke of PROMPTERA — backend pytest 20/20 passed; frontend web preview functional. Backend covers health/config, auth (register+dup+login+me invalid/valid), pricing (ID IDR Rp249.000 / Rp1.199.000 / monthly_equivalent Rp99.917 + savings_pct, US USD), subscription (me/checkout pending/dev-activate->pro/cancel->free), AI gateway disabled (503), /ai/usage enabled=false, /ai/languages (13 langs + 5 modes), analytics allow/deny. Frontend covers onboarding skip + permission step + finish, scripts list with seeded samples, search filter, chip filter, favorite toggle, open editor via card, create new script, editor title/content/word/char/duration/speed chips, Tools tab grid, Library tab empty state, Settings tab (Teleprompter + Camera controls visible), Paywall loads backend pricing (Rp249.000, Rp1.199.000, ≈Rp99.917/bln, hemat 60%, 'PALING HEMAT' badge on yearly), Auth register flow returns to tabs, dev-activate flips user to PRO (settings badge shows PRO), standalone teleprompter at /teleprompter?scriptId=sample_1 renders script, countdown animates, and faster/font-up/mirror/play controls work. No deprecated expo packages. AI translate 503 and checkout pending are by design.

issues: 'paywall-demo-activate' button sits below the fold on 390x844; requires scroll to be visible. Consider adding bottom padding or sticky secondary action so it is reachable without manual scroll on small devices.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Appears on initial render. Non-blocking but should migrate StyleSheet shadow* -> boxShadow for react-native-web compatibility.

action_items: (Optional, polish) Migrate StyleSheet shadow* props to boxShadow to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
(Optional UX) Ensure 'Simulasikan pembayaran (demo)' button on paywall is visible without manual scroll on small viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py <600 lines, async MongoDB via Motor, EmailStr validation, bcrypt, JWT with iss/aud, DuplicateKeyError -> 409 — clean.
ObjectId correctly converted to str via public_user(); no _id leakage.
Pricing is backend-driven and localized (IDR dot thousands, USD with 2 decimals). Monthly equivalent correctly computed.
AI translate is cleanly disabled via DEEPSEEK_API_KEY empty check -> 503 (by design).
Analytics event allowlist prevents arbitrary event writes.
Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD; test suite uses .app domains.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of covered flows (onboarding, scripts, editor, tools, library, settings, paywall, auth-register, dev-activate to PRO, teleprompter standalone)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests register fresh users with prefix test_<uuid>@promptera.app each run. UI test registered ui<ts>@promptera.app and dev-activated to PRO. No shared/global seed modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clear web localStorage before testing onboarding (localStorage.clear() + reload). Onboarding path: click text 'Lewati' then [data-testid=onboarding-finish]. EmailStr rejects .test TLD -- use .app. Paywall demo-activate button is below the fold on 390x844 -- scrollTo bottom first. Teleprompter standalone URL: /teleprompter?scriptId=sample_1 (sample_1/sample_2 are seeded). Backend AI translate returns 503 by design (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY empty), checkout returns pending by design.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced. Initial pytest run failed with 422 because Pydantic EmailStr blocked the .test TLD (reserved); fixed by using @promptera.app in generated test emails. UI 'fav filter empty after toggle' was a test-side false-negative: sample_1 ships with isFavorite=true, so a single star tap toggled it OFF and the Favorit chip correctly rendered empty — behaviour is correct.
